name: Data plan template
pitch: Generate a data management plan template tailored to a specific funder's requirements.
instructions: Search the web for the funder's name and data management plan requirements. Read the official guidelines and note the required sections, word limits and formatting rules. If no specific funder is named, ask the person which funder they are applying to. Create a new blank text file in the workspace. Write a template structure with placeholder sections matching the funder's required headings. Add brief instructions inside each placeholder, for example 'Describe the types of data you will collect and your strategy for sharing'. Save the completed template file and show it to the person, noting any sections that remain blank because the guidelines were not available.
starters: generate a data plan for my funder
make a template for my data management plan

examples.ask: i need a template for the eu horizon 2020 data management plan
examples.does: search the web for eu horizon 2020 data management plan requirements and create a template with the required sections
ask which funder the template is for, then search and produce a blank template file

examples.ask: can you draft a dmp for the wellcome trust
examples.does: search the wellcome trust data management guidance and produce a template file with their headings

readme:
# data plan template
Generates a data management plan template tailored to a specific funder's requirements.

What it does: searches for the funder's DMP guidelines, creates a blank template file with the required sections and placeholder text.

What it needs: web search to find the guidelines, browser snapshot to read them, file write to save the template, make page to format the output.

What it will not do: it cannot guess funder-specific requirements if the guidelines are not publicly available; it will ask the person which funder they are applying to if none is named.
